使用 skills/goai-survey-writer/SKILL.md 做有界组稿重试。禁止重新通读全部 papers 或联网检索；消费现有 taxonomy.md、contribution.md、coverage_report.json、style_notes.md、ideas 目录、references.bib 及已有图。快速产出 notes/citation_bank.md（至少80个真实 key-claim 行，来自 references.bib；运行 bank_check，阈值不足时记录 decision 后按比例调整）；产出 drafts/blueprint.md 与完整英文 article：main.tex、sections/*.tex，覆盖摘要、近邻体系引言、背景、合成与相图、致密化、微结构/界面、结构–电导关系、测量可比性、讨论、Open Problems（模型预测明确标注）和双段结论。仅使用 references.bib key；使用 fig1/fig2，预留 fig3。运行 bib_guard、tex_guard、academic_language_guard，尽力 pdflatex 编译生成 main.pdf；记录 revision_log.md。设置 draft_complete PASS/WARN 并 loopctl 日志。关键产物：/home/gaojing/goai_synthesis_runs/20260903_synthesis_topics/01_llzo/notes/citation_bank.md,/home/gaojing/goai_synthesis_runs/20260903_synthesis_topics/01_llzo/drafts/blueprint.md,/home/gaojing/goai_synthesis_runs/20260903_synthesis_topics/01_llzo/drafts/main.tex,/home/gaojing/goai_synthesis_runs/20260903_synthesis_topics/01_llzo/drafts/main.pdf
